name: rvas-diagrams
description: Excalidraw sources + builders for the RVAS docs diagrams.

scripts.build: node build-journey.mjs && node build-landscape.mjs && node build-assessment.mjs && node build-proof-flow.mjs
scripts.render: node render.mjs journey.excalidraw journey.svg && node render.mjs landscape.excalidraw landscape.svg && node render.mjs assessment.excalidraw assessment.svg && node render.mjs proof-flow.excalidraw proof-flow.svg
scripts.all: npm run build && npm run render && npm run publish-svg
